questions.prompt: What is the Act V town called?
questions.explanation: Harrogath is the last Barbarian stronghold, besieged at the foot of Mount Arreat.

questions.prompt: Baal is the Lord of what?
questions.explanation: Baal is the Lord of Destruction, the final Prime Evil and namesake of the expansion.

questions.prompt: Baal is fought at the end of which area?
questions.explanation: Baal holds the Worldstone Keep atop Mount Arreat, in the Throne of Destruction chamber.

questions.prompt: Harrogath is held by defenders of which people?
questions.explanation: Harrogath is the last stronghold held by Barbarian defenders.

questions.prompt: What role does Nihlathak fill in Harrogath?
questions.explanation: Nihlathak serves as the gambling merchant in Harrogath: 'The siege has everything in short supply…except fools.'

questions.prompt: Which of these is one of the Barbarian's three skill trees?
questions.explanation: The Barbarian's trees are Combat Masteries, Combat Skills, and Warcries.

questions.prompt: Mount Arreat protects what sacred object at its peak?
questions.explanation: Mount Arreat hides the Worldstone, a fragment of creation that the Barbarians have sworn for generations to guard.

questions.prompt: Which of these is NOT one of the Druid's three skill trees?
questions.explanation: Combat Masteries belongs to the Barbarian. The Druid's trees are Elemental, Shape Shifting, and Summoning.

questions.prompt: Among the three Prime Evils, Baal is the…
questions.explanation: Mephisto is eldest (Hatred), Diablo is middle (Terror), Baal is youngest (Destruction).

questions.prompt: Which of these is an Act V surface area?
questions.explanation: The Frozen Tundra, Arreat Plateau, and Bloody Foothills all belong to Act V's mountain siege.
